title: Fresh Blender 5.2 holdout for inverse-depth support and Position-bound motion control
question: On a fresh rigid edge-on Blender 5.2 Cycles fixture, does reciprocal-depth interpolation restore at least 1024 same-Material NEITHER-horizontal structural witnesses that direct Z interpolation rejects, while Position binds the Vector pass to the actual first hit, every NEITHER witness remains unavailable to one-sided curvature, and two clean repeats preserve decoded pass and cross-language decision identity?
decisionRole: Targeted confirmation of a projective-depth correction and a Position-only control oracle. This experiment cannot repair H1, establish global coverage, validate TOP/BOTTOM acceptance, or authorize compiler promotion.

scientificClassification.targetedFreshMeasurement: The world trajectory is the previously unselected C2 analytic candidate NEITHER-000060. The 201x137 raster, render seed, Material/Object tokens, mesh tessellation, Generated signal, view layer and all EXRs are new after C2, H1 and P1.
scientificClassification.pilotInformed: H1 partial arrays disclosed direct-Z failure and an inverse-depth replay. P1 disclosed Position semantics on the forbidden H1 fixture. A new unsaved zero-render scalar raster pilot established only the structural witness domain for this different trajectory and raster; none of those inputs is an H2 rendered measurement.
scientificClassification.pairedIntervention: Direct bilinear Z and reciprocal-depth interpolation are evaluated on identical four-tap previous Depth values. Only reciprocal-depth is permitted to enter the frozen H2 structural decision.
scientificClassification.negativeResultValue: Insufficient rescued witnesses, Position/Vector mismatch, any NEITHER acceptance, repeat or language divergence, or any evidence-chain failure is retained. No fixture, threshold, tolerance, process count or verdict mapping may be repaired after formal rendering.

requirements: Commit and push this exact spec and protocol before creating any H2 tool byte, preflight root, formal root or EXR.
Commit and push all eight H2 tools in a later tool-freeze commit before creating the preflight or formal root.
Run an official zero-render preflight after tool freeze. It must execute analyzer-on-probe-shaped-report schema smoke and leave the formal root absent.
Only an accepted preflight commit permits the runner to create the formal root and exactly four new factory-empty Blender 5.2 Cycles CPU renders.
No H1 or P1 EXR, decoded array or mask may be an H2 measurement input. C2 candidate-table bytes may be used only to bind the declared trajectory identity.
Retain any failed formal root. A tool or execution failure produces no scientific verdict and the same experiment ID may not be repaired and rerun.

disclosedZeroRenderPilot.implementation: Blender-bundled Python imported only the frozen C2 scalar calibration functions and evaluated C2 candidate NEITHER-000060 at a 4x4 grid of new raster sizes.
disclosedZeroRenderPilot.forbiddenInference: The pilot did not observe Cycles coverage, Position, Depth, Vector, Material Index, Combined RGB, reciprocal-depth error, decision arrays, repeat identity or any H2 verdict.

sceneContract.construction: fresh factory state; one newly tessellated rigid foreground plane and one background plane; continuous Generated object-local emission; no source blend, external asset, texture, light, transparency, deformation, simulation, compositor, denoiser, motion blur or depth of field

ownerTokenContract.objectIndexNegativeControl: Both owners deliberately share Object Index 24400. Object Index is recorded but forbidden as owner identity.
ownerTokenContract.materialIndexDecisionInput: Exact finite float32 equality to the declared integer token.

decisionInputBoundary.filesystemBoundary: Adapters write decision and control arrays into separate directories. Python and Node consumers receive only the decision directory and may not traverse to control arrays.
forbidden: current RGB except alpha registration and exact fallback

projectiveDepthCandidate.preconditions: all four previous depths are finite and strictly positive; all four Material tokens equal current Material token; all four alpha values exceed 0.999
projectiveDepthCandidate.predictedDepth: derived only in analysis from current Position, current owner rigid transform, previous owner rigid transform and previous camera projection

positionControlOracle.previousPoint: previous owner transform applied to the local point recovered from currentPoint
positionControlOracle.decisionIsolation: Position is available to analyzer/auditor only and never to either consumer.

structuralContract.registeredCurrent: finite current decision inputs; alpha>0.999; declared nonzero Material token
structuralContract.bilinearSupport: four in-bounds previous taps with alpha>0.999 and exact same Material token
structuralContract.projectiveDepthValid: reciprocal-depth result passes the frozen relative depth gate
structuralContract.currentInterior: current pixel and all current neighbors within Chebyshev radius 2 have the same Material token and alpha>0.999
structuralContract.neitherHorizontal: at least one of the two bilinear rows has neither same-owner left nor same-owner right outer tap
structuralContract.oneSidedUnavailable: neither horizontal support or neither vertical support exists; the pixel must not enter curvature risk
structuralContract.fallback: every registered non-accepted pixel copies current float32 RGBA exactly

measurementContract.projectiveDepthRescued: inverse-depth passes and direct-Z control fails on the same registered same-owner four-tap cell
measurementContract.measurementRegion: full 201x137 frame; no crop or post-render denominator change

preflightContract.sourceSceneProbe: construct factory-empty scene, inspect passes, mesh, scale, transforms, tokens and render settings without invoking render
preflightContract.consumerSyntheticArithmetic: fixed synthetic taps prove direct-Z and reciprocal-depth paths are distinct and canonical in Python and Node
preflightContract.analyzerProbeSchemaSmoke: invoke the frozen analyzer in smoke mode on probe-shaped self-hashed source, adapter, consumer, execution and receipt records; every later-read key must be exercised
preflightContract.runnerFailureSemanticsStatic: verify the runner finally-path writes execution, failure and receipt for a forced pre-render child failure without creating the formal root

onAnyChildFailure: retain all existing outputs and logs

requiredFamilies: source report, EXR binding, subimage roster, channel, decoded-array and metadata mutations
Material token zero/reuse/swap/undeclared and Object/Material substitution
mesh, scale, transform, raster, seed and Generated-signal mutations
Position control leakage into consumer decisions and control-directory traversal
Vector sign/order, Position transform and camera-projection mutations
direct-Z substituted for reciprocal depth, reciprocal/weight/tap/order/sign and relative-depth tolerance mutations
rescued-set suppression, NEITHER suppression, unavailable/accepted injection and denominator mutations
current RGB decision dependence, fallback mutation and future RGB leakage
repeat, cross-language, result, audit, execution, receipt and failure-finally chain mutations
attacks.independence: Auditor may use Python standard library, NumPy and OpenImageIO but may not import source, adapter, consumer, analyzer or runner implementations. Every counted attack is one isolated in-memory semantic mutation that must trigger a named gate.

decision.supportedWhen: All identity, freshness, source, Position control, decoded-repeat, metadata, filesystem-isolation, reciprocal-depth, rescued-set, NEITHER rejection, fallback, cross-language, process, audit and attack gates pass in both repeats.
decision.notSupportedWhen: All evidence integrity and safety gates pass, but the frozen minimum same-owner, reciprocal-depth-valid, rescued or NEITHER witness count is not met.
decision.rejectedWhen: Any identity, freshness, source, Position, repeat, metadata, isolation, formula, cross-language, fallback, NEITHER acceptance, process, audit or attack gate fails.
decision.invalidated: A frozen tool or execution failure produces MATERIAL_OWNER_PROJECTIVE_DEPTH_HOLDOUT_INVALIDATED_BY_TOOL_OR_EXECUTION_FAILURE with scientificVerdict null.

promotionBoundary: A supported H2 verdict establishes only that reciprocal-depth preserves the targeted NEITHER structural domain and Position controls Vector on one fresh opaque rigid-planar emission fixture. It does not validate TOP/BOTTOM reconstruction quality, broad scenes or production use. The next step returns to the SceneSpec compiler B01/B02 reproducibility gate; this H2 result remains a quarantined algorithm candidate until a later compiler-stage integration experiment is preregistered.
nonClaims: No H1 scientific verdict is created or repaired.
This fixture does not establish curved, deforming, transparent, hair, volume, lit, shadowed, denoised, motion-blurred or depth-of-field behavior.
A correct Position control oracle does not authorize Position as a reconstruction decision input.
A reciprocal-depth pass does not prove RGB reconstruction quality because every measured NEITHER witness is required to remain unaccepted.
The pilot is construction evidence, not a blind holdout or raster-phase robustness claim.
A supported result does not enter the production compiler or override the B01/B02 structural reproducibility requirements.
